name: Azure management group
short_description: A management group is a container above Azure subscriptions that lets organizations arrange many subscriptions into one hierarchy; access and policies assigned there are inherited by every subscription underneath.

evidence.quote: They are the management group, the subscription, the resource group, and the resource.
